risk_note: Admin 订单查询 manual sync (apps/admin pages/orders/**, texts/orders.ts). Contract CT-24n adminCreateOrderSync, adminListOrderSyncs, adminGetOrderSyncLimits; backend B1-09i merged. order.view, no step-up and no Idempotency-Key; 【手动同步】 by time window (platform/from/to only) or by order numbers (platform/order_nos, 1-max_order_nos), limits read only when the dialog opens, 【同步记录】 read only on click, 【同步此单】 on the detail; reused / 30156 / 10403 / 429 / 20001 notices kept distinct, double click sends once. The status filter is left as a TODO (no values registered for any platform; orchestrator technical decision). Prerequisite test-change F1-07ea (#2028) merged; no frozen test changed here. Rule tests written by an independent Claude in three rounds; Claude spec-test review r1 fail (1 S1), r2 fail (1 S1), r3 pass; red on the test machine (red/1-2). Implementation by Opus 5.5 with a small round 2 for the two S2 of the money review (earliest time rounded up to the minute; platform-not-supported notice for 【同步此单】); test machine verify-fast and browser green after rebasing on main. Adversarial money review by fresh independent Claude: r1 pass (2 S2, fixed), r2 incremental pass. Written by hand.

reviews.note: round 1 pass with two S2 (both fixed in implementation round 2), round 2 incremental pass with no findings; independent Claude because Codex is unavailable until 2026-11-02
